HediffDef.label: neural assimilation
HediffDef.description: The construct's biological neural bus is actively integrating a newly installed bioware augment. Synaptic mapping requires temporary dormancy.

HediffDef.label: interrupted stasis
HediffDef.description: This construct was forcibly awakened from a hibernation cycle before neural and metabolic defragmentation was complete. The unit experiences severe cognitive lag and sluggish motor responses (-20%).

HediffDef.label: buffered stasis interruption
HediffDef.description: This construct was awakened early from a specialized stasis pod. The pod's dampening buffer mitigated the shock of interruption to a moderate cognitive deficit (-10%).
